title: Classification as Search Infrastructure: How Category Creation, Addition and Cleanup Shape Knowledge Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.37343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classification systems shape how searchers find relevant objects. We study how revisions to classification architecture affect retrieval by changing the routes through which objects enter consideration. We theorize that creating a cross-cutting category can reduce classificatory distance and translation costs, whereas adding routes to an established system can increase route-selection and updating costs; category cleanup can restore contrast. Empirically, we exploit the 2013 creation and 2020 revision of Y02/Y04 green-technology codes in the Cooperative Patent Classification. We match treated patents to unchanged green patents within technology-cohort cells and estimate examiner- and applicant-specific effects on first-citation timing and citation volume. translated_title: 分类作为搜索基础设施：类目创建、增加与清理如何影响知识检索
translated_abstract: 分类体系塑造了搜索者寻找相关对象的方式。我们研究分类架构的修订如何通过改变对象进入考量范围的路径来影响检索效果。我们从理论上提出：创建一个交叉类目可以降低分类距离和转换成本，而向既有体系中添加路径则会增加路径选择和更新成本；类目清理则可以恢复类目间的区分度。在实证部分，我们利用了合作专利分类（CPC）中2013年创建和2020年修订的Y02/Y04绿色技术代码。我们将受处理的专利与技术队列单元内未发生变化的绿色专利进行匹配，并估计了审查员和申请人在首次引用时间和引用量上的差异化效应。研究发现，类目创建与审查员首次引用风险提高25%相关。在成熟体系中，类目增加与审查员引用风险降低13-15%相关，而类目清理则与……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 本文利用合作专利分类中Y02/Y04绿色技术代码的创建与修订这一自然实验，发现创建交叉类目可显著加快知识检索（审查员首次引用风险提高25%），而在成熟体系中增加类目反而会降低检索效率（引用风险降低13-15%），类目清理则有助于恢复类目间的区分度。
en_tdlr: Exploiting the 2013 creation and 2020 revision of Y02/Y04 green-technology codes in the Cooperative Patent Classification, this paper shows that creating a cross-cutting category speeds up knowledge retrieval (25% higher examiner first-citation hazard), while adding routes to a mature system slows it down (13-15% lower hazards), and category cleanup restores contrast.
